title: SafeStep Allowance Account: Annual Grants, Rollover and Expiry
content:
# The SafeStep Allowance Account

The allowance balance of a SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program is the employer-funded allowance available to the program's participants and not yet redeemed, in US dollars. Annual grants and returned purchases increase it; redemptions (the employer-paid portion) and expiries or forfeitures decrease it.

For one participant, one product type and one allowance year, the **remaining allowance** as of a purchase is the total of that participant's grants and restored returns for that product type and year, less the employer-paid portions of that participant's redemptions and the amounts expired or forfeited for that product type and year.

## Annual grant

On the first day of each allowance year, the tier's grant date, every participant on the roster is granted the tier's safety footwear allowance for safety footwear and, where the tier covers it, the tier's prescription safety eyewear allowance for prescription safety eyewear, plus the tier's orthotic allowance and accessories allowance where above 0.00.

Each participant receives at most one grant per product type for an allowance year. Whether a grant has already been made is read from the company's own allowance records for that participant, product type and allowance year.

| Already granted for this participant, product type and allowance year? | Grant made? |
|---|---|
| No | Yes, once |
| Yes | No second grant |

## Year end: rollover and expiry

At the allowance year end the tier's rollover percentage of each participant's unused allowance per product type, rounded half up to the cent, is added to the next year's grant and the rest expires; on a tier whose rollover is 0 all unused allowance expires.

The rollover is worked separately for each product type: the unused allowance of that type is multiplied by the rollover percentage, the result is rounded half up to the cent, that rounded amount is added to the next year's grant of the same type, and the unused allowance less that rounded amount expires.

### Worked year-end figures (hypothetical amounts and rates)

| Unused allowance of one product type | Rollover percentage | Carried into next year's grant | Expires |
|---|---|---|---|
| 80.00 | 25 percent | 20.00 | 60.00 |
| 10.10 | 25 percent | 2.53 (2.525 rounded half up) | 7.57 |
| 10.10 | 50 percent | 5.05 | 5.05 |
| 45.00 | 0 percent | 0.00 | 45.00 |

With a hypothetical annual footwear allowance of 200.00 and 20.00 carried forward, the next year's footwear grant is 220.00.
